author: (Carpenter, 1888)

note.en: A feather star that hides in crevices by day and climbs up to feed at night; known here only from museum records.
note.es: Un lirio de mar que se esconde en grietas de día y sube a alimentarse de noche; conocido aquí solo por registros de museo.

evidence: GBIF: 2 records in the region (many are museum specimens)
